cases.description: Test case where the key is null. Expecting a NullPointerException to be thrown.

group: put method - key length is zero

cases.description: Test case where the key has zero length. If the root is empty, it should store the key-value pair.
Test case where the key has zero length and the root is not empty. Expecting the method to update the value at the root.

group: put method - key found and empty

cases.description: Test case where the key exists but is empty. Expecting the method to store the new key-value pair and increment size.

group: put method - key found and not empty

cases.description: Test case where the key exists and is not empty. Expecting the method to update the value and increment mod count.

group: put method - new key with valid bit index

cases.description: Test case where a new key is added with a valid bit index. Expecting the method to add the entry and return null.

group: put method - new key with null bit key

cases.description: Test case where a new key is added with a null bit key. Expecting the method to store the key-value pair at the root.

group: put method - new key with equal bit key

cases.description: Test case where a new key is added with an equal bit key but not at the root. Expecting the method to update the value.
Test case where an invalid bit index is encountered. Expecting an IllegalArgumentException to be thrown.
Test case where an invalid bit index is encountered. Expecting an IllegalArgumentException to be thrown.

group: put method - key with non-empty value

cases.description: Test case where a non-empty key is added with a non-empty value. Expecting the method to add the entry and return null.

group: put method - key with duplicate value

cases.description: Test case where a key that already exists is added with the same value. Expecting the method to return null.

group: put method - key with special characters

cases.description: Test case where a key with special characters is added. Expecting the method to add the entry and return null.

group: put method - key with long string

cases.description: Test case where a very long key string is added. Expecting the method to add the entry and return null.

group: put method - key found and updated with a new value

cases.description: Test case where an existing key is updated with a new value. Expecting the method to update the value and return the new value.

group: put method - key with empty string value

cases.description: Test case where a key is added with an empty string value. Expecting the method to add the entry and return null.

group: put method - key found with equal bit key but not root

cases.description: Test case where a key is found with an equal bit key but not at the root. Expecting the method to update the value.
